verdict.rationale: YYLO is a local command-line orchestrator. Its tasks, Ledger records, wiki and artifacts are kept as Git-native records inside the user's own checkout, and Ledger views are served locally, so the user implicitly controls where this data lives. The evidence never addresses data residency or region choice directly. It also says nothing about where data goes once it is sent to the delegated agents and models (e.g. a Claude subagent). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of data residency or storage location, residency controls for data sent to agent and model providers, and any independent corroboration.
